picks.title: Meta says its GEM ads model lifted conversions 18.9% across its apps
picks.excerpt: Click-through rates rose 12% as Meta folded ad prediction for every surface into one model trained on thousands of GPUs. What can advertisers actually check?
picks.rationale: Meta reports concrete numbers (conversions up 18.9%, CTR up 12%) from merging ad prediction for all its surfaces into one generative model, and that changes what advertisers should expect from Meta delivery.

picks.title: LG And Magnite Launch Agentic Home Screen Ads With A Winning NFL Quarterback
picks.excerpt: Magnite and LG Ad Solutions announced LG smart TV home screen inventory will be available to agencies through agentic AI media buying.
picks.rationale: A live launch puts LG smart TV home screen inventory up for agentic AI media buying. It is a concrete new CTV surface that buyers' agents can now purchase.

picks.title: Your Store Is 'Agent-Ready' By Default, We Tested 122 Shopify Stores To See What That Actually Means
picks.excerpt: From testing top Shopify stores, Bill Hunt found agents can build a checkout, but can't answer basic delivery or cancellation questions.
picks.rationale: Original testing of 122 Shopify stores shows AI agents can build a checkout but cannot answer basic delivery or cancellation questions, which gives merchants a concrete gap to fix for agentic selling.

picks.title: Floqer's AI agents research sales prospects so teams don't have to
picks.excerpt: The problem Floqer is trying to solve is familiar to anyone who has worked in sales or revenue operations.
picks.rationale: AI agents that do prospect research for B2B revenue teams are a direct change to outbound sales and lead-generation workflows.

picks.title: Newegg adds Google UCP checkout integration
picks.excerpt: The electronics retailer says integrating Google's Universal Commerce Protocol will allow shoppers to discover and purchase Newegg products directly within Google Search, AI Mode and Gemini experiences.
picks.rationale: A major retailer goes live with in-chat checkout in Google AI Mode and Gemini through UCP. It is a concrete merchant adoption of agentic commerce, separate from Google's own 10-08 hub launch.

alternates.title: OpenAI ChatGPT Ads Account Manager
alternates.excerpt: OpenAI has humans who are reaching out to advertisers to help them manage their ChatGPT Ads.
alternates.rationale: Backup only. This is part of the running OpenAI agency sales push for ChatGPT Ads (Adweek, 10-10), so it is treated as a repeat.

dedup.note: Picked 5 of 15, from 5 distinct outlets. Dropped as a repeat: SER 'OpenAI ChatGPT Ads Account Manager'. Its history_match (Muse 10-11) is spurious, but the item continues OpenAI's agency sales push for ChatGPT Ads (Adweek 10-10, 'permanent line item in agency media plans') with no new product or release. Newegg UCP (history_match related to the 10-08 Merchant Center UCP hub) was kept as new because it is a distinct retailer's own go-live announcement, not more coverage of Google's hub. The SEJ Shopify test is original testing data, not a rewrite of the 10-14 Verge Shopify catalog story. Meta GEM (a unified ads model with conversion and CTR lift numbers) is a different topic from the 10-13 Meta engineering post on opportunistic inference capacity.
